name: Han Wo
bio: Han Wo (韓偓) was a poet of the late T’ang dynasty and an official at the court of the Emperor Zhaozong. Besides poems of court and politics he wrote the ornate love poems later gathered as the Xianglian ji (香奩集).
The poem here is the original in Chinese, as selected by Sun Zhu for the Three Hundred Tang Poems (唐詩三百首, 1763).

poems.title: 已涼 (Yi liang)
poems.author: Han Wo
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
碧闌干外繡簾垂，猩血屏風畫折枝。
八尺龍鬚方錦褥，已涼天氣未寒時。
